name: Julius Muia
detail: Treasury Principal Secretary in March 2021: Treasury was "in discussions over the wealth tax", no position.

name: John Kitui
detail: Oxfam in Kenya country director; the quote found is about low taxes on the richest, not a wealth tax. Oxfam in Kenya itself is recorded.

name: Ruth Odinga
detail: Kisumu Woman Representative: luxury sectors such as aviation should pay more (a sector tax).

name: Francis Atwoli
detail: COTU: asked to tax "heavily" people who acquired property through dubious means (2018); an anti-corruption measure, not a wealth tax.

name: Ole Sapit and the church councils
detail: Opposed tax rises on ordinary Kenyans and pointed to leakages; no call to tax wealth found.

name: Kenya Finance Bill 2024 vehicle circulation tax
detail: Press loosely called the annual motor-vehicle levy a "wealth tax"; it is a vehicle tax, withdrawn after the protests.
